## About this notebook

This notebook contains the data preparation, tag density model, stock and age composition, and ratio estimator code behind the manuscript *Estimating missing coded-wire tag recoveries from unsampled strata in a mixed-stock Chinook Salmon troll fishery under a non-random missingness structure* (Kvistad, *North American Journal of Fisheries Management*). The manuscript is the authoritative description of the methods and results; the text here is a brief guide to the code. Every number quoted below is computed inline from the objects created in this document.

Uncertainty intervals, the Dirichlet prior sensitivity analysis (Table S1), and the hold-out evaluation are produced by separate scripts in `R/` that use the objects created here. Run `R/run_all.R` from the repository root to reproduce everything.

**Context.** The North of Falcon troll fisheries (Washington Marine Areas 1–4 and 4B) were identified in CTC Report 46 (PSC 2021) as having catch without sampling in the RMIS catch and sample reports. A CWT expansion factor ($N^{Caught} / N^{Sampled}$) is undefined when nothing is sampled, and no CWTs are recovered from those strata, so tagged fish in that catch are missing from the CTC exploitation rate analysis. Unaccounted fishery mortality biases calendar year exploitation rates (CYERs) for PST indicator stocks. This analysis estimates the CWT recoveries, by stock and age, expected in the unsampled catch.

```{r}
#| label: load libraries for making quarto documents
#| echo: false

# Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(gt)
library(MissMech)

#Helper function
assign_region <- function(stock) {
  case_when(
    stock %in% c('ELW','GAD','NIS','NSF','GRO','GRN','HOK','SAM','SKF','SSF',
                 'STL','SKY','WHY','WRY','WHF','WRF','SKS','SPY') ~ "Puget Sound",
    stock %in% c('QNT','QN2','SOO','QUE','QUI')                   ~ 'WA Coast',
    stock %in% c('SUM','URB','SPR','LYY','LYF','HAN','KLM','MSH',
                 'NIC','SHU','SMK')                               ~ 'Columbia River',
    stock %in% c('ATN','BQR','CHI','CHU','COW','CKO','HAR','RBT',
                 'NAN','DOM')                                     ~ 'Canada',
    stock %in% c('LRH','WSH','CWF','LRW','ELK','SRH','SRN')       ~ 'Oregon',
    stock %in% c('ALP')                                           ~ 'Alaska',
    TRUE                                                          ~ 'Non-PST stocks'
  )
}

# Format a number for inline reporting: thousands separator, no scientific
# notation, rounded to `digits` decimal places. Used for every dynamic value
# referenced in the prose so that formatting is consistent throughout.
nfmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(round(x, digits), format = 'f', digits = digits, big.mark = ',')
}

# Shared color palette: same colors for the same regions in every figure
region_colors <- c(
  'Alaska'         = viridis::viridis(7)[1],
  'Canada'         = viridis::viridis(7)[2],
  'WA Coast'       = viridis::viridis(7)[3],
  'Puget Sound'    = viridis::viridis(7)[4],
  'Columbia River' = viridis::viridis(7)[5],
  'Oregon'         = viridis::viridis(7)[6],
  'Non-PST stocks' = viridis::viridis(7)[7]
)

season_of <- function(m) ifelse(m %in% c(11, 12, 1:4), 'winter', 'summer')

# Study period. Change here only; every filter and caption reads from these.
START_YEAR <- 2005
END_YEAR   <- 2023
# RMIS tag_status codes counted as a CWT physically present in the fish:
# 1 read OK, 3 lost before read, 4 not readable, 7 unresolved discrepancy.
# Excluded: 2 no tag, 8 head not processed, 9 pseudo tag / blank wire.
TAG_PRESENT <- c(1, 3, 4, 7)
```

```{r}
# Filter on catch location name to NOF areas

                                    '4 & 4B (TROLL)', 
                                    '4 & 4B & 5 TR. TROLL',
```

## Data

Catch and sample reports for all troll fisheries were retrieved from RMIS for `r START_YEAR`–`r END_YEAR` and filtered to the North of Falcon catch areas (Washington Marine Areas 1–4 and 4B). Both treaty and non-treaty fisheries have substantial catch with no sampling (@fig-missing). Treaty catch location names in RMIS were not defined consistently over time, so treaty areas other than Marine Area 2 were consolidated to a single "3,4 TT" label. The Marine Area 2 treaty fishery has no sampling in the full time series and is excluded.

Little's MCAR test (manuscript Methods) uses the stratum-level data prepared in the `littles-mcar` chunk.

```{r}
#| label: janitorial-services
#| echo: false
dat$fishery_name <- case_when(dat$fishery == 10 ~ 'Non-treaty',
                              dat$fishery == 15 ~ 'Treaty')

#Extract catch month from statistical week
dat$catch_month <- lubridate::month(as.Date(paste0(dat$catch_year, "-", dat$period, '-', 10), format = "%Y-%W-%u"))
dat[is.na(dat$catch_month),]$catch_month <- 12 #Fill in NAs due to weeks 53 and 54

dat$catch_location_name <- case_when(
  dat$catch_location_name == "4B  -TREATY TROLL" ~ "4B TT",
  dat$catch_location_name == "4A  -TREATY TROLL" ~ "4A TT",
  dat$catch_location_name == "4 & 4B (TROLL)" ~ "4 & 4B TT",
  dat$catch_location_name == "4 & 4B & 5 TR. TROLL" ~ "4, 4B, & 5 TT",
  dat$catch_location_name == "4 & 4B & 5 & 3 TR. TROLL" ~ "4, 4A, 4B, 5, & 3 TT",
  dat$catch_location_name == "MARINE AREA 1" ~ "MA 1",
  dat$catch_location_name == "MARINE AREA 2" ~ "MA 2",
  dat$catch_location_name == "MARINE AREA 3" ~ "MA 3",
  dat$catch_location_name == "MARINE AREA 4" ~ "MA 4"
)

#Roll up treaty troll, excluding treaty MA 2
dat[dat$fishery == 15 & dat$catch_location_name != 'MA 2',]$catch_location_name <- '3,4 TT'
#MA 2 TT
MA2TT <- dat[dat$catch_location_name == 'MA 2' & dat$fishery == 15,]

catch_by_month <- dat |>
  group_by(catch_year, catch_month, fishery, catch_location_name) |>
  summarize(number_caught = sum(number_caught, na.rm = T),
            number_sampled = sum(number_sampled, na.rm = T),
            number_cwt_estimated = number_caught/number_sampled,
            number_recovered_decoded = sum(number_recovered_decoded, na.rm = T)) |>
  ungroup()

#write.csv(catch_by_month, "Auxiliaries/NOF Troll/out/catch_by_month.csv", row.names = F)
```

The `qaqc` chunk below separates catch and sample records into those with catch but no sampling (`dat1`), sampling but no reported catch (`dat2`), zero catch with non-zero sampling (`dat3`), and complete records (`dat4`). The latter two anomalous cases are treated as clerical errors and excluded.

```{r}
#| label: qaqc
#| echo: false

#Fish caught but none sampled
dat1 <- dat[dat$number_caught > 0 & dat$number_sampled == 0,]
#Fish sampled but catch not reported
dat2 <- dat[is.na(dat$number_caught) & dat$number_sampled > 0,]
#Fish caught reported as 0 but >0 fish sampled
dat3 <- dat[dat$number_caught == 0 & !is.na(dat$number_caught),]
#Rows done properly (i.e., numeric values present in both number caught and number sampled)
dat4 <- dat[dat$number_caught > 0 & dat$number_sampled > 0,]
```

## Monthly strata

RMIS reporting strata are statistical weeks. Catch and sampling are aggregated to months (year × month × fishery × area), so recoveries from sampled weeks expand to the full monthly catch and unsampled weeks within a sampled month need no separate estimate. The strata that remain are months with catch but no sampling at all; both estimators target these.

## Stock assignments

PST indicator stock and brood year are assigned to each recovered tag code from a lookup derived from the Pacific Salmon Commission's Chinook Analysis Modeling Platform (CAMP; see `data/README.md`). Tag codes not in the lookup are non-PST stocks.

```{r}
#| label: stock-lookup
#| echo: false

# PST indicator stock assignments by tag code, derived from the PSC CAMP
# database (see data/README.md). The full CAMP database is not public.
pad_tag <- function(x) str_pad(as.character(x), width = 6, pad = '0')

stock_lookup <- read.csv("data/derived/indicator_stock_lookup.csv",
                         colClasses = c(tag_code = "character")) |>
  mutate(tag_code = pad_tag(tag_code))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(stock_lookup$tag_code))
```

## Tag density

CWT recoveries are counted from the RMIS recovery file using only records with a tag physically present (`TAG_PRESENT`: tag status 1, 3, 4 or 7). Recoveries per landed fish vary strongly by month (@fig-cwt-per-100), so tag density cannot be assumed constant across sampled and unsampled strata.

```{r}
#| label: cwt-recoveries
#| echo: false

# tag_code is read as character so leading zeros survive (e.g. "062958");
# read.table would otherwise convert it to integer and break the CAMP join.
rmis_recovery <- read.table(file = "data/raw/NOF Troll Recoveries 2005-2025.txt",
                            sep = ',', header = TRUE,
                            colClasses = c(tag_code = 'character'))

rmis_recovery$recovery_date <- ymd(rmis_recovery$recovery_date)
rmis_recovery$month <- month(rmis_recovery$recovery_date)

# Guard: every year with sampling must have recoveries. A missing year in the
# download (as happened with 2015) would otherwise enter the model as zeros.
yrs_sampled <- catch_by_month |>
  filter(number_sampled > 0) |>
  distinct(catch_year) |> pull()
yrs_recov <- unique(rmis_recovery$run_year)
stopifnot("Sampled years with no recoveries in the RMIS file" =
            all(yrs_sampled %in% yrs_recov))
```

```{r}
#| label: pred-new
#| echo: false

# Partition strata into observed (sampled) and predicted (unsampled).
# No sampling model is needed: the offset GAM predicts CWT counts directly
# from observed catch, so landed catch is the only quantity required for
# prediction and it is reported in every stratum.
# Partition strata by presence of sampling (independent of any model)
catch_by_month_sampling <- catch_by_month |>
  filter(number_sampled != 0) |>
  as.data.frame()

catch_by_month_no_sampling <- catch_by_month |>
  filter(number_sampled == 0) |>
  filter(!(fishery == 15 & catch_location_name == 'MA 2')) |>
  as.data.frame()

# The `type` label is set directly on each partition. (It was previously
# derived from a `notes` column added by the removed nearest-neighbor chunk.)
catch_by_month_all <- bind_rows(
  catch_by_month_no_sampling |> mutate(type = 'Predicted'),
  catch_by_month_sampling    |> mutate(type = 'Observed'))

preds <- catch_by_month_all |>
  group_by(catch_year, catch_month, catch_location_name, fishery, type) |>
  summarize(
    number_caught = sum(number_caught, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Prediction frame for the GAM. Column names are aligned to those used when
# fitting; `fishery` and `recovery_location_name` are coerced to factors with
# the levels seen in fitting so that predict() cannot encounter a new level.
pred_dat <- preds |>
  rename(run_year               = catch_year,
         month                  = catch_month,
         recovery_location_name = catch_location_name) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-cwt-per-100
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: Median CWT recoveries per 100 landed catch in the North of Falcon Chinook troll fishery (2005--2023). One outlier removed.

# Rename recovery locations to match catch-side labels (must precede aggregation)
rmis_recovery <- rmis_recovery |>
  filter(run_year >= START_YEAR, run_year <= END_YEAR) |>
  mutate(recovery_location_name = case_when(
    recovery_location_name == "4B  -TREATY TROLL"        ~ "4B TT",
    recovery_location_name == "4A  -TREATY TROLL"        ~ "4A TT",
    recovery_location_name == "4 & 4B (TROLL)"           ~ "4 & 4B TT",
    recovery_location_name == "4 & 4B & 5 TR. TROLL"     ~ "4, 4B, & 5 TT",
    recovery_location_name == "4 & 4B & 5 & 3 TR. TROLL" ~ "4, 4A, 4B, 5, & 3 TT",
    recovery_location_name == "MARINE AREA 1"            ~ "MA 1",
    recovery_location_name == "MARINE AREA 2"            ~ "MA 2",
    recovery_location_name == "MARINE AREA 3"            ~ "MA 3",
    recovery_location_name == "MARINE AREA 4"            ~ "MA 4",
    TRUE ~ recovery_location_name)) |>
  # Roll up treaty troll, excluding treaty MA 2 -- mirrors catch-side logic
  mutate(recovery_location_name = ifelse(
    fishery == 15 & recovery_location_name != 'MA 2',
    '3,4 TT', recovery_location_name))

# CWT recoveries by month, year, fishery, and area
# Count only records where a CWT was physically present (TAG_PRESENT); heads
# with no tag, unprocessed heads and blank wire are not CWT recoveries.
recov <- rmis_recovery |>
  filter(tag_status %in% TAG_PRESENT) |>
  group_by(run_year, month, fishery, recovery_location_name) |>
  summarize(cwt_recovs = n(), .groups = 'drop') |>
  as.data.frame()

#Generate unique ID combining month, year, fishery, and area
recov$unique_id <- paste0(recov$run_year,'-',recov$month,'-',recov$fishery,'-',recov$recovery_location_name)
catch_by_month$unique_id <- paste0(catch_by_month$catch_year,'-',catch_by_month$catch_month,'-',catch_by_month$fishery,'-',catch_by_month$catch_location_name)

#Join catch and sample data to rmis recovery counts
cwt_encounter <- left_join(recov, catch_by_month[,c('unique_id','number_caught','number_sampled','number_cwt_estimated')], by = 'unique_id')

#Calculate CWT encounter rate
cwt_encounter <- cwt_encounter |>
  mutate(xi=(cwt_recovs/number_caught)) |>
  mutate(xi=ifelse(xi >=1, 1, xi)) |>
  mutate(xi_per100=(cwt_recovs/number_caught)*100) |>
  mutate(month = as.integer(month)) |>
  filter(!(fishery == 15 & recovery_location_name == 'MA 2'))

p <- cwt_encounter |>
  filter(run_year != 2022 & month != 10) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(mu = median(xi_per100, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = mu)) +
  geom_col(col = 'black', fill = 'azure2') +
  labs(caption = "Note: October 2022 data excluded as outlier") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(3,6,9,12), limits = c(1,12)) +
  ylab("Number per 100 landed catch") +
  xlab('Month') +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
p

ggsave(filename = "out/cwt_recovs_per100.png", plot = last_plot(), height=4.5, width = 7.5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

The encounter rate per landed fish, $\xi = N^{CWT}/N^{Caught}$ (@eq-xi; @fig-cwt-encounter-rate), describes seasonal and spatial variation in recoveries. The model, however, estimates tag density among sampled fish:

$$\xi = \frac{N^{CWT}}{N^{Caught}}$$ {#eq-xi}

$$\theta = \frac{N^{CWT}}{N^{Sampled}}$$ {#eq-theta}

Expected recoveries in the landed catch of an unsampled stratum follow from applying the predicted tag density to the reported catch, $\widehat{CWT} = \hat{\theta}\cdot N^{Caught}$. No estimate of the missing sampling is needed.

```{r}
#| label: fig-cwt-encounter-rate

cwt_encounter |>
  # filter(fishery == 10) |>
  # filter(fishery == 15) |>
  filter(run_year != 2022 & month != 10) |>
  group_by(month, recovery_location_name) |>
  summarize(median = median(xi, na.rm = T)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = median, color = as.factor(recovery_location_name))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +

ggsave(filename = "out/cwt_encounter.png", plot = last_plot(), height = 4, width = 7, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

### Tag density model

Recovery counts are modeled with a Tweedie GAM (log link) fit in `mgcv` (Wood 2011), with sampling effort as an offset (@eq-gam):

$$\begin{aligned}
N^{CWT}_i &\sim \text{Tweedie}(\mu_i,\phi,p) \\
\log(\mu_i) &= \log(N^{Sampled}_i) + \mathbf{X}_i\boldsymbol{\beta}+\sum_j f_j(x_{ij})
\end{aligned}$$ {#eq-gam}

with smooths on `run_year` and `month` and a parametric effect of `recovery_location_name`. Fishery is determined by recovery location after consolidation and is not a separate term. The fitting frame is built from sampled strata, so sampled strata with zero recoveries are retained. Predictions for unsampled strata substitute $\log(N^{Caught})$ for the offset (`gam-predictions` chunk). @fig-mean-variance shows the response distribution and the fitted Tweedie variance function.

```{r}
#| label: gam
#| echo: false
#| output: false
library(mgcv)

# Fitting frame. Built from the SAMPLED CATCH STRATA, with recovery counts
# joined on, so that sampled strata with zero recoveries are retained.
# (Building it from the recovery table, as previously, silently dropped every
# sampled stratum without a recovery and biased theta-hat upward.)
recov_counts <- recov |>
  filter(run_year >= START_YEAR, run_year <= END_YEAR) |>
  select(run_year, month, fishery, recovery_location_name, cwt_recovs)

cwt_fit_all <- catch_by_month |>
  filter(catch_year >= START_YEAR, catch_year <= END_YEAR,
         !(fishery == 15 & catch_location_name == 'MA 2')) |>
  transmute(run_year = catch_year,
            month    = as.integer(catch_month),
            fishery,
            recovery_location_name = catch_location_name,
            number_caught, number_sampled) |>
  left_join(recov_counts,
            by = c('run_year', 'month', 'fishery', 'recovery_location_name')) |>
  mutate(cwt_recovs = replace_na(cwt_recovs, 0L))

cwt_fit <- cwt_fit_all |>
  # Require valid sampling effort and catch
  filter(!is.na(number_sampled), number_sampled > 0,
         !is.na(number_caught),  number_caught > 0) |>
  # Drop strata reporting more recoveries than sampled fish (theta > 1)
  filter(cwt_recovs <= number_sampled) |>
  # Offset term. At fitting this is sampling effort; at prediction the same
  # slot is filled with log(number_caught) to scale tag density to the full
  # landed catch (see the gam-predictions chunk).
  mutate(log_exposure = log(number_sampled))

# Recoveries reported in strata with no sampling or no catch record. These
# cannot enter the fit and are reported as an exclusion.
recov_unmatched <- recov_counts |>
  anti_join(cwt_fit_all |> filter(number_sampled > 0, number_caught > 0),
            by = c('run_year', 'month', 'fishery', 'recovery_location_name')) |>
  filter(!(fishery == 15 & recovery_location_name == 'MA 2'))

#Define area levels for modeling consistency
cwt_fit$recovery_location_name <- factor(cwt_fit$recovery_location_name,
                                         levels = c('3,4 TT','MA 1','MA 2','MA 3','MA 4'))

# Verify the fitting frame before use
stopifnot(sum(!is.finite(cwt_fit$log_exposure)) == 0,
          sum(is.na(cwt_fit$cwt_recovs))        == 0,
          max(cwt_fit$cwt_recovs / cwt_fit$number_sampled) <= 1)

m <- gam(cwt_recovs ~ s(run_year) + s(month) + offset(log_exposure) +
           recovery_location_name,
         family = tw(link = 'log'), data = cwt_fit, method = 'REML')

# ## Model diagnostics
plot_data <- data.frame(
  observed  = cwt_fit$cwt_recovs / cwt_fit$number_sampled,
  fitted    = fitted(m) / cwt_fit$number_sampled,
  residuals = residuals(m)
)
# 
# obs_fit <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = observed, y = fitted)) +
#   geom_point(shape = 1, size = 2) +
#   geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = 'red', lty = 2) +
#   scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
#   labs(x = expression("Observed "*theta), y = expression("Fitted "*theta)) +
#   theme_bw() +
#   theme(text = element_text(size = 14))
# 
# resid_fit <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = fitted, y = residuals)) +
#   geom_point(shape = 1, size = 2) +
#   geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
#   scale_x_log10() +
#   labs(x = expression("Fitted "*theta), y = "Deviance residuals") +
#   theme_bw() +
#   theme(text = element_text(size = 14))
# 
# cowplot::plot_grid(obs_fit, resid_fit, labels = "auto")

# Power (p) and dispersion (phi) parameters
p <- m$family$getTheta(trans = TRUE)
phi <- m$sig2

## Values referenced inline in the text -----------------------------------
## Defining these as named objects keeps reported numbers in sync with the
## pipeline; do not hard-code figures in the prose.

n_fit       <- nrow(cwt_fit)
n_fit_zero  <- sum(cwt_fit$cwt_recovs == 0)   # sampled strata with no recoveries
tags_fit    <- sum(cwt_fit$cwt_recovs)

# Strata and tags removed at each exclusion step
n_excl_zero_samp <- nrow(recov_unmatched)
tags_zero_samp   <- sum(recov_unmatched$cwt_recovs)
theta_gt1        <- cwt_fit_all |>
  filter(number_sampled > 0, number_caught > 0, cwt_recovs > number_sampled)
n_excl_theta_gt1 <- nrow(theta_gt1)
tags_theta_gt1   <- sum(theta_gt1$cwt_recovs)

# Reconciliation: every recovery in the study period is either fitted or
# accounted for by an exclusion
stopifnot(tags_fit + tags_zero_samp + tags_theta_gt1 ==
            sum(recov_counts$cwt_recovs[
              !(recov_counts$fishery == 15 &
                  recov_counts$recovery_location_name == 'MA 2')]))

dev_expl <- summary(m)$dev.expl
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-k-fold-cv
#| echo: false
#| results: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig.height: 5.5
#| fig.width: 9
#| fig-cap: "Ten-fold cross-validated predictions plotted against observed values for (a) CWT recovery counts and (b) tag density ($\\theta$, recoveries per fish sampled). Axes are on a square-root scale; dashed red lines show a 1:1 relationship. Agreement on the count scale largely reflects sampling effort, which enters the model as an offset; panel b removes sampling effort and shows agreement in the quantity the model estimates. Point area in panel b is proportional to the number of fish sampled; the wider scatter among small-sample strata reflects sampling variability in observed tag density."
#| fig-pos: "H"

# K-fold cross-validation predictions
cv_pred <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(cwt_fit))
k <- 10
set.seed(8202024)
folds <- sample(1:k, nrow(cwt_fit), replace = TRUE)

for(i in 1:k) {
  train_data <- cwt_fit[folds != i, ]
  test_data  <- cwt_fit[folds == i, ]
  temp_model <- gam(cwt_recovs ~ s(run_year) + s(month) + offset(log_exposure) +
                      recovery_location_name,
                    family = tw(link = 'log'), data = train_data, method = 'REML')
  cv_pred[folds == i] <- predict(temp_model, newdata = test_data, type = 'response')
}

# Plot cross-validation results
# (a) counts, arithmetic axes: absolute agreement, dominated by large strata.
# (b) tag density, theta = recoveries / fish sampled: the quantity the model
#     estimates, with sampling effort removed. Point area scales with fish
#     sampled, since small-sample strata carry noisy observed theta.
cv_dat <- tibble(obs_n     = cwt_fit$cwt_recovs,
                 cv_n      = cv_pred,
                 n_sampled = cwt_fit$number_sampled,
                 obs_theta = obs_n / n_sampled,
                 cv_theta  = cv_n  / n_sampled) |>
  filter(!is.na(cv_n))

lim_n     <- range(c(cv_dat$obs_n, cv_dat$cv_n))
lim_theta <- range(c(cv_dat$obs_theta, cv_dat$cv_theta))

# Square-root axes spread the dense low end without dropping zero strata (a
# log scale would), and keep the 1:1 line straight. Equal limits and a fixed
# aspect ratio keep the 1:1 line at 45 degrees.
p_cv_n <- ggplot(cv_dat, aes(x = obs_n, y = cv_n)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = 'red', lty = 2) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1.8, fill = 'grey40', color = 'grey15',
             alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0.3) +
  scale_x_sqrt(limits = lim_n, breaks = c(0, 10, 50, 200, 500, 1000, 1500)) +
  scale_y_sqrt(limits = lim_n, breaks = c(0, 10, 50, 200, 500, 1000, 1500)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = 'Observed CWT recoveries', y = 'Predicted CWT recoveries') +
  theme_bw() + theme(text = element_text(size = 13),
                     panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_cv_theta <- ggplot(cv_dat, aes(x = obs_theta, y = cv_theta, size = n_sampled)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = 'red', lty = 2) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = 'grey40', color = 'grey15',
             alpha = 0.45, stroke = 0.3) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 7, breaks = c(100, 1000, 5000, 10000),
                  labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_x_sqrt(limits = lim_theta, breaks = c(0, 0.02, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1)) +
  scale_y_sqrt(limits = lim_theta, breaks = c(0, 0.02, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = expression("Observed "*theta), y = expression("Predicted "*theta),
       size = 'Fish sampled') +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 13),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = 'bottom',
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 25, 5.5, 5.5))   # top, right, bottom, left (pt)

fig_cv <- cowplot::plot_grid(p_cv_n, p_cv_theta, labels = 'auto',
                             align = 'h', axis = 'tb')
fig_cv
ggsave(filename = 'out/cwt_cv_predictions.png', fig_cv, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = 'white')

ok <- !is.na(cv_pred)
cv_calibration <- sum(cv_pred[ok]) / sum(cwt_fit$cwt_recovs[ok])
cv_bias        <- mean(cv_pred[ok] - cwt_fit$cwt_recovs[ok])
cv_r2          <- cor(cv_pred[ok], cwt_fit$cwt_recovs[ok])^2
cv_rmse        <- sqrt(mean((cv_pred[ok] - cwt_fit$cwt_recovs[ok])^2))

# Agreement on the tag density scale (Figure 8b); weighted by fish sampled
theta_obs <- cwt_fit$cwt_recovs / cwt_fit$number_sampled
theta_cv  <- cv_pred / cwt_fit$number_sampled
cv_r2_theta   <- cor(theta_cv[ok], theta_obs[ok])^2
cv_r2_theta_w <- cov.wt(cbind(theta_cv[ok], theta_obs[ok]),
                        wt = cwt_fit$number_sampled[ok], cor = TRUE)$cor[1, 2]^2

# Seasonal calibration (quoted in the Discussion)
win <- season_of(cwt_fit$month) == 'winter'
cv_cal_winter <- sum(cv_pred[win & ok])  / sum(cwt_fit$cwt_recovs[win & ok])
cv_cal_summer <- sum(cv_pred[!win & ok]) / sum(cwt_fit$cwt_recovs[!win & ok])
n_winter_fit  <- sum(win)

# Offset-only comparison. Deviance explained is reported relative to a model
# containing the offset alone, since sampling effort would otherwise dominate.
m_null <- gam(cwt_recovs ~ offset(log_exposure),
              family = tw(link = 'log'), data = cwt_fit, method = 'REML')

# AIC comparison uses ML: REML likelihoods are not comparable across models
# differing in their fixed-effect structure.
m_ml      <- update(m,      method = 'ML')
m_null_ml <- update(m_null, method = 'ML')
delta_aic <- AIC(m_null_ml) - AIC(m_ml)

c(calibration = cv_calibration, bias = cv_bias,
  r2 = cv_r2, rmse = cv_rmse, delta_aic = delta_aic)
```

The model was fit to `r nfmt(n_fit)` sampled strata, including `r n_fit_zero` in which no CWTs were recovered. Because sampling effort is accounted for by the offset, deviance explained is reported relative to an offset-only model: year, month, and recovery location explained `r round(dev_expl*100, 1)`% of the remaining deviance, and the fitted model was strongly favored over the offset-only alternative ($\Delta$AIC = `r round(delta_aic, 1)`). To assess out-of-sample prediction capability, I conducted a k-fold cross validation routine (k=10). Cross-validated predictions tracked observed counts closely ($R^2$ = `r round(cv_r2, 2)`; RMSE = `r round(cv_rmse, 1)`) and reproduced aggregate recoveries to within `r round(abs(cv_calibration-1)*100, 1)`% (@fig-k-fold-cv a). Because counts scale with sampling effort, agreement on the count scale largely reflects the offset. On the tag density scale, cross-validated predictions explained `r round(cv_r2_theta_w*100)`% of the variation in observed $\theta$ when strata were weighted by the number of fish sampled (`r round(cv_r2_theta*100)`% unweighted; @fig-k-fold-cv b). Calibration was `r round(cv_cal_winter, 2)` in the `r n_winter_fit` sampled winter strata and `r round(cv_cal_summer, 2)` in summer strata. Note that cross-validation evaluates prediction within sampled strata; the assumption that tag density transports to unsampled strata cannot be tested with these data.

```{r}
# Substitute landed catch for sampling effort in the offset. Because theta-hat
# estimates tag density among fish caught, evaluating it against the full catch
# rather than the sampled portion performs the sample-to-catch expansion.
pred_dat$log_exposure <- log(pred_dat$number_caught)

# verify before predicting
sum(!is.finite(pred_dat$log_exposure))
setdiff(unique(pred_dat$recovery_location_name), unique(cwt_fit$recovery_location_name))

pred_dat$cwt_recovs <- predict(m, newdata = pred_dat, type = 'response')

sum(pred_dat$cwt_recovs[pred_dat$type == 'Predicted'])   # all stocks, unsampled strata
```

```{r}
sum(pred_dat$cwt_recovs[pred_dat$type=='Predicted']) /

summary(pr$cwt_recovs / pr$number_caught)
range(pr$run_year); table(pr$month)

weighted.mean(pr$se_link, pr$number_caught)

# Zero-recovery strata: how plausible is each zero under the fitted model?
# A zero where many recoveries were expected points to missing recovery data
# (as with 2015 before the re-download), not to tag-free catch.
zero_check <- cwt_fit |>
  mutate(expected = fitted(m)) |>
  filter(cwt_recovs == 0) |>
  mutate(season = ifelse(month %in% c(11, 12, 1:4), 'winter', 'summer'),
         band   = cut(expected, c(0, 1, 3, 10, Inf),
                      labels = c('<1', '1-3', '3-10', '>10')))
count(zero_check, band, season)
zero_check |> arrange(desc(expected)) |> head(15)
```

### Stock and age composition

Predicted recoveries are apportioned to stock and age using the composition of decoded tags (tag status 1) recovered in the same month and area over a lagging five-year window (years $t-4$ through $t$), with the time-pooled month × area composition as a fallback where the window has no recoveries. Lost, unreadable and unresolved tags count toward tag density but are assumed to share the composition of decoded tags. Brood year for tag codes outside the indicator stock lookup comes from the RMIS release file. Ages are truncated to 0–5, and ages below 2 are dropped.

This chunk produces the point estimate of composition. The Dirichlet treatment of composition uncertainty (empirical Bayes prior, $\kappa = 50$) is in `R/method2_uncertainty.R`.

```{r}
#| label: stock-composition
#| echo: false

#Stock composition estimated from CWT returns

#First add stock directly from CAMP if available
cwt_releases <- stock_lookup

# Standardize tag codes on both sides of the join: character, six digits with
# leading zeros restored. A type or padding mismatch here silently sends
# indicator-stock tags to 'Other'.
pad_tag <- function(x) str_pad(as.character(x), width = 6, pad = '0')
rmis_recovery$tag_code <- pad_tag(rmis_recovery$tag_code)
cwt_releases$tag_code  <- pad_tag(cwt_releases$tag_code)

# Composition uses decoded tags only (tag_status 1). Lost, unreadable and
# unresolved tags count toward tag density but are assumed to share the
# composition of decoded tags.
tmp <- left_join(rmis_recovery |> filter(tag_status == 1),
                 cwt_releases[,c("tag_code","stock","brood_year")], by = "tag_code")

# If stock is not in CAMP, then it's an 'Other'
tmp[is.na(tmp$stock),]$stock <- 'Other'
#write.csv(tmp[is.na(tmp$stock),], file = 'Auxiliaries/NOF Troll/out/stock_missing.txt', row.names = F, quote = F)

#Separate out the tag codes with no match in CAMP
check <- tmp[tmp$stock == 'Other',] #Records without a release location code
#unique(check$tag_code) #INVALID TAG CODES -- Check for leading zeroes
#write.table(unique(check$tag_code), file = 'Auxiliaries/NOF Troll/out/tag_codes_check.txt', row.names = F, quote = F)

#Age composition - need to pull brood year from RMIS for tag_codes that weren't in CAMP
#For records with no stock in CAMP, join stock_location_code from RMIS and assign manually
rmis_release <- read.table(file = "data/raw/NOF Troll Tag Releases.txt", sep = ',', header = T)
rmis_release$tag_code_or_release_id <- as.character(rmis_release$tag_code_or_release_id)
#Fix leading zeroes issue
rmis_release$tag_code_or_release_id <- pad_tag(rmis_release$tag_code_or_release_id)

#Add brood_year from RMIS release records
tmp2 <- left_join(check, rmis_release[,c("tag_code_or_release_id","brood_year")], by = c("tag_code" = "tag_code_or_release_id")) |>
  select(-brood_year.x) |>
  rename(brood_year = "brood_year.y")

#Merge back with rest of data
res2 <- rbind(tmp[tmp$stock != 'Other',], tmp2)
```

Observed monthly stock and age composition (@fig-stock-comp) shifts sharply between seasons: Puget Sound stocks and younger fish make up a much larger share of recoveries in winter (November–April) than in summer (May–October). Season-level summaries are in Table 1 of the manuscript.

```{r}
#| label: stock-age-comp
#| echo: false

#stock/age composition grouped by month, area, and fishery
stock_age_comp <- res2 |>
  mutate(age = run_year - brood_year) |>
  mutate(age = ifelse(age < 0, 0, age)) |> #Truncate ages <0 to 0.
  mutate(age = ifelse(age >= 5, 5, age)) |> #Truncate ages >5 to 5.
  filter(age > 1) |> #Filter small number of Age <1
  group_by(month, stock, age, recovery_location_name) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            number_cwt_estimated = sum(number_cwt_estimated)) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  mutate(prop = n/sum(n, na.rm = T)) |>
  mutate(region = case_when(
    stock %in% c('ELW','GAD','NIS','NSF','GRO','GRN','HOK','SAM','SKF','SSF','STL','SKY','WHY','WRY','WHF','WRF','SKS','SPY')~"Puget Sound",
    stock %in% c('QNT','QN2','SOO','QUE','QUI')~'WA Coast',
    stock %in% c('SUM','URB','SPR','LYY','LYF','HAN','KLM','MSH','NIC','SHU','SMK')~'Columbia River',
    stock %in% c('ATN','BQR','CHI','CHU','COW','CKO','HAR','RBT','NAN','DOM')~'Canada',
    stock %in% c('LRH','WSH','CWF','LRW','ELK','SRH','SRN')~'Oregon',
    stock %in% c('ALP')~'Alaska',
    stock %in% 'Other'~'Non-PST stocks')) |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c('Alaska','Canada','WA Coast','Puget Sound','Columbia River','Oregon','Non-PST stocks'))) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-cwt-stock-age
#| results: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-pos: "H"
#| fig-cap: Predicted CWT recoveries from unsampled strata in the North of Falcon Chinook troll fishery (2005--2023) apportioned into stock and age specific components. 
#| fig-width: 8
#| echo: false
#stock/age composition grouped by month, area, and fishery
stock_age_comp <- res2 |>
  mutate(age = run_year - brood_year) |>
  mutate(age = ifelse(age < 0, 0, age)) |>
  mutate(age = ifelse(age >= 5, 5, age)) |>
  filter(age > 1) |>
  # Expand each recovery into a lagging 5-year window: a recovery from year t
  # informs composition for window-years t through t+4. Composition in year t
  # reflects brood cohorts already recruited to the fishery, so the window
  # draws only on prior and concurrent years.
  cross_join(tibble(year_offset = 0:4)) |>
  mutate(window_year = run_year + year_offset) |>
  # Calculate proportions within each window_year-month-area
  group_by(window_year, month, stock, age, recovery_location_name) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            number_cwt_estimated = sum(number_cwt_estimated),
            .groups = 'drop') |>
  group_by(window_year, month, recovery_location_name) |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(region = case_when(
    stock %in% c('ELW','GAD','NIS','NSF','GRO','GRN','HOK','SAM','SKF','SSF','STL','SKY','WHY','WRY','WHF','WRF','SKS','SPY') ~ "Puget Sound",
    stock %in% c('QNT','QN2','SOO','QUE','QUI') ~ 'WA Coast',
    stock %in% c('SUM','URB','SPR','LYY','LYF','HAN','KLM','MSH','NIC','SHU','SMK') ~ 'Columbia River',
    stock %in% c('ATN','BQR','CHI','CHU','COW','CKO','HAR','RBT','NAN','DOM') ~ 'Canada',
    stock %in% c('LRH','WSH','CWF','LRW','ELK','SRH','SRN') ~ 'Oregon',
    stock %in% c('ALP') ~ 'Alaska',
    stock %in% 'Other' ~ 'Non-PST stocks')) |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c('Alaska','Canada','WA Coast','Puget Sound','Columbia River','Oregon','Non-PST stocks'))) |>
  ungroup()

# Create the pooled composition as a fallback
pooled_comp <- res2 |>
  mutate(age = run_year - brood_year) |>
  mutate(age = ifelse(age < 0, 0, age)) |>
  mutate(age = ifelse(age >= 5, 5, age)) |>
  filter(age > 1) |>
  group_by(month, stock, age, recovery_location_name) |>
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') |>
  group_by(month, recovery_location_name) |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(region = case_when(
    stock %in% c('ELW','GAD','NIS','NSF','GRO','GRN','HOK','SAM','SKF','SSF','STL','SKY','WHY','WRY','WHF','WRF','SKS','SPY') ~ "Puget Sound",
    stock %in% c('QNT','QN2','SOO','QUE','QUI') ~ 'WA Coast',
    stock %in% c('SUM','URB','SPR','LYY','LYF','HAN','KLM','MSH','NIC','SHU','SMK') ~ 'Columbia River',
    stock %in% c('ATN','BQR','CHI','CHU','COW','CKO','HAR','RBT','NAN','DOM') ~ 'Canada',
    stock %in% c('LRH','WSH','CWF','LRW','ELK','SRH','SRN') ~ 'Oregon',
    stock %in% c('ALP') ~ 'Alaska',
    stock %in% 'Other' ~ 'Non-PST stocks')) |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c('Alaska','Canada','WA Coast','Puget Sound','Columbia River','Oregon','Non-PST stocks'))) |>
  ungroup()

# Partition predicted catch into stock/age components
stock_age_comp_dat <- pred_dat |>
  rename(year = run_year) |>
  mutate(cwt_id = row_number()) |>
  left_join(stock_age_comp, by = c('year' = 'window_year', 'month', 'recovery_location_name')) |>
  mutate(cwt_by_stock_age = cwt_recovs * prop)

# Split into matched and unmatched
matched <- stock_age_comp_dat |> filter(!is.na(prop))
unmatched <- stock_age_comp_dat |> filter(is.na(prop))

# For unmatched rows, drop the empty stock/age columns and rejoin with pooled comp
unmatched_fixed <- unmatched |>
  select(year, month, recovery_location_name, fishery, cwt_id,
         number_caught, cwt_recovs, type) |>
  distinct() |>
  left_join(pooled_comp, by = c('month', 'recovery_location_name')) |>
  mutate(cwt_by_stock_age = cwt_recovs * prop)

# Recombine
stock_age_comp_dat <- bind_rows(matched, unmatched_fixed)

## Values referenced inline in the text ---------------------------------
pred_only <- stock_age_comp_dat |> filter(type == 'Predicted')

total_pred        <- sum(pred_dat$cwt_recovs[pred_dat$type == 'Predicted'],
                         na.rm = TRUE)
total_apportioned <- sum(pred_only$cwt_by_stock_age, na.rm = TRUE)
total_pst         <- sum(pred_only$cwt_by_stock_age[
                           pred_only$region != 'Non-PST stocks'], na.rm = TRUE)

# Strata that matched neither the windowed nor the pooled composition table
n_unapportioned   <- pred_only |> ungroup() |> filter(is.na(prop)) |>
                       distinct(cwt_id) |> nrow()
cwt_unapportioned <- total_pred - total_apportioned

# Guard: every value referenced inline must be a single number. A grouped
# tibble upstream would otherwise render as a comma-separated vector.
stopifnot(all(lengths(list(total_pred, total_apportioned, total_pst,
                           n_unapportioned, cwt_unapportioned)) == 1))

# Composition data density, referenced in the discussion
comp_n <- pred_only |>
  filter(!is.na(prop)) |>
  group_by(cwt_id) |>
  summarise(n_comp = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE),
            catch  = first(number_caught), .groups = 'drop')
n_sparse_strata <- sum(comp_n$n_comp < 10)
pct_catch_sparse <- 100 * sum(comp_n$catch[comp_n$n_comp < 10]) /
                          sum(pred_only$number_caught[!duplicated(pred_only$cwt_id)])

# Plot -- predicted (unsampled) strata only. stock_age_comp_dat also carries
# the observed strata, which would otherwise be stacked into the same bars.
pred_only |>
  filter(!is.na(region)) |>
  group_by(region, age, fishery) |>
  summarize(sum = sum(cwt_by_stock_age, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(fishery = case_when(
    fishery == 10 ~ "Non-tribal",
    fishery == 15 ~ "Tribal",
    TRUE          ~ as.character(fishery)
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = sum, fill = region)) +
  geom_bar(position = 'stack', stat = 'identity', color = 'black') +
  labs(x = 'Age', y = 'Estimated CWT recoveries', fill = 'Stock region') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  facet_wrap(~fishery)
ggsave(filename = "out/cwt_res.png", plot = last_plot(), height = 4, width = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

### Ratio estimator

The ratio estimator (manuscript Equation 2) borrows tag density and composition from the nearest sampled donor stratum in the same fishery and area, within 90 days between month midpoints (ties go to the earlier donor; zero-recovery donors are included):

$$\widehat{CWT}_{u,k} = N^{Caught}_u \cdot \theta_d \cdot p_{d,k}, \qquad \theta_d = \frac{N^{CWT}_d}{N^{Sampled}_d}$$ {#eq-ratio}

where $u$ is the unsampled stratum, $d$ its donor, and $p_{d,k}$ the donor's decoded-tag composition for stock-age category $k$. It is applied to the same unsampled strata as the tag density model.

```{r}
#| label: ratio-estimator
#| echo: false
#| output: false

# Ratio estimator (manuscript Equation 2), applied to the
# SAME unsampled strata as the tag density model so the two are comparable.
SEARCH_WINDOW   <- 90     # days between month midpoints
MIN_SAMPLE_FRAC <- 0.05   # donor sampling-fraction floor, sensitivity only
mid <- function(y, m) as.Date(sprintf('%d-%02d-15', y, m))

recip <- pred_dat |>
  filter(type == 'Predicted') |>
  transmute(r_id    = row_number(), run_year, month,
            area    = recovery_location_name,
            fishery = as.character(fishery),
            catch_r = number_caught,
            td_pred = cwt_recovs,
            date    = mid(run_year, month))

re_rec <- res2 |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(run_year >= START_YEAR, run_year <= END_YEAR) |>
  mutate(fishery = as.character(fishery),
         age     = pmin(pmax(run_year - brood_year, 0), 5),
         region  = assign_region(stock))

# Donors: every sampled stratum in the fitting frame, zeros included
donors <- cwt_fit |>
  transmute(d_year = run_year, d_month = month,
            area = as.character(recovery_location_name),
            fishery = as.character(fishery),
            n_sampled_d = number_sampled, catch_d = number_caught,
            cwt_d = cwt_recovs, d_date = mid(run_year, month))

matched_re <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(recip)), function(i) {
  r <- recip[i, ]
  cand <- donors |>
    filter(area == r$area, fishery == r$fishery) |>
    mutate(gap = abs(as.numeric(d_date - r$date))) |>
    filter(gap <= SEARCH_WINDOW) |>
    arrange(gap, d_date)                       # ties: earlier donor
  if (nrow(cand) == 0) return(NULL)
  bind_cols(r, cand[1, ] |> select(-area, -fishery))
})

unmatched_re <- anti_join(recip, matched_re, by = 'r_id')

donor_comp <- re_rec |>
  count(d_year = run_year, d_month = month, area = recovery_location_name,
        fishery, stock, age, region, name = 'n')

# Donor tag density (all tags physically present, from cwt_fit) is split by the
# composition of the donor's DECODED tags. Lost or unreadable tags are thereby
# assumed to share the decoded composition, as in the tag density model.
donor_dec <- donor_comp |>
  group_by(d_year, d_month, area, fishery) |>
  summarise(n_dec = sum(n), .groups = 'drop')

est_re <- matched_re |>
  left_join(donor_dec,  by = c('d_year', 'd_month', 'area', 'fishery')) |>
  left_join(donor_comp, by = c('d_year', 'd_month', 'area', 'fishery'),
            relationship = 'many-to-many') |>
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0L), n_dec = replace_na(n_dec, 0L),
         est = ifelse(n_dec > 0,
                      catch_r * (cwt_d / n_sampled_d) * (n / n_dec), 0))

## Values referenced inline in the text ---------------------------------
method1_all <- sum(matched_re$catch_r * matched_re$cwt_d / matched_re$n_sampled_d)
method1_pst <- est_re |>
  filter(!is.na(region), region != 'Non-PST stocks') |>
  summarise(x = sum(est)) |> pull(x)

# Recoveries that cannot be apportioned: donor had tags but none decoded
method1_unapportioned <- matched_re |>
  left_join(donor_dec, by = c('d_year', 'd_month', 'area', 'fishery')) |>
  filter(is.na(n_dec) | n_dec == 0) |>
  summarise(x = sum(catch_r * cwt_d / n_sampled_d)) |> pull(x)

# Components plus unapportioned must reconcile to the all-stocks total
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(sum(est_re$est) + method1_unapportioned, method1_all)))

n_re_matched   <- nrow(matched_re)
n_re_unmatched <- nrow(unmatched_re)
catch_re_unmatched <- sum(unmatched_re$catch_r)
td_on_matched  <- sum(matched_re$td_pred)                    # tag density, same strata

low_frac        <- matched_re$n_sampled_d / matched_re$catch_d < MIN_SAMPLE_FRAC
n_low_frac      <- sum(low_frac)
method1_all_hi  <- sum((matched_re$catch_r * matched_re$cwt_d /
                          matched_re$n_sampled_d)[!low_frac])
re_scale_ratio  <- matched_re$catch_r / matched_re$n_sampled_d   # L_r / N_d

winter_donors   <- matched_re |>
  filter(season_of(month) == 'winter') |>
  count(donor_season = season_of(d_month))
n_winter_recip  <- sum(winter_donors$n)
n_winter_summer_donor <- sum(winter_donors$n[winter_donors$donor_season == 'summer'])

stopifnot(all(lengths(list(method1_all, method1_pst, td_on_matched,
                           method1_all_hi, n_winter_summer_donor)) == 1))
```

A supplementary analysis (not part of the estimator) borrows, for strata without a donor in the search window, from the same fishery, area and month in the nearest sampled year, up to five years away:

```{r}
#| label: ratio-estimator-tier2
#| echo: false
#| output: false

# Side analysis (not part of the estimator): for strata with no donor within
# SEARCH_WINDOW, borrow from the same fishery, area and month in the nearest
# sampled year, up to 5 years away. Main results use tier 1 only.
MAX_YEAR_GAP <- 5

t2_match <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(unmatched_re)), function(i) {
  r <- unmatched_re[i, ]
  cand <- donors |>
    filter(area == r$area, fishery == r$fishery, d_month == r$month) |>
    mutate(gap = abs(d_year - r$run_year)) |>
    filter(gap <= MAX_YEAR_GAP) |>
    arrange(gap, d_year)
  if (nrow(cand) == 0) return(NULL)
  bind_cols(r, cand[1, ] |> select(-area, -fishery))
})

t2_n         <- nrow(t2_match)
t2_zero      <- sum(t2_match$cwt_d == 0)
t2_zero_fish <- sum(t2_match$catch_r[t2_match$cwt_d == 0])
t2_re        <- sum(t2_match$catch_r * t2_match$cwt_d / t2_match$n_sampled_d)
t2_td        <- sum(t2_match$td_pred)
t2_samp_rng  <- range(t2_match$n_sampled_d)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-res
#| fig-cap: "Estimated CWT recoveries in unsampled strata of the North of Falcon Chinook troll fishery (2005--2023) from the nearest-donor ratio estimator, by stock region and age."
#| echo: false
#| fig.width: 8
#| fig.height: 4
#| fig-pos: H

est_re |>
  filter(!is.na(stock), age > 1) |>
  mutate(region  = factor(region, levels = names(region_colors)),
         fishery = ifelse(fishery == '15', 'Tribal', 'Non-tribal')) |>
  group_by(region, age, fishery) |>
  summarise(sum = sum(est), .groups = 'drop') |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = sum, fill = region)) +
  geom_col(color = 'black') +
  labs(x = 'Age', y = 'Estimated CWT recoveries', fill = 'Stock region') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  facet_wrap(~fishery)
ggsave(filename = "out/cwt_res_re.png", plot = last_plot(), height = 4, width = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

## Results

### Tag density model

Predicted CWT recoveries in the `r nrow(recip)` unsampled strata total `r nfmt(total_pred)` (point estimate). Of these, `r nfmt(total_apportioned)` could be apportioned to stock and age; the remaining `r nfmt(cwt_unapportioned)` fall in `r n_unapportioned` strata with no recoveries in the corresponding month and area over the full time series. Of the apportioned total, `r nfmt(total_pst)` are PST indicator stocks (@fig-cwt-stock-age).

These are point estimates. The posterior medians and 95% credible intervals reported in the manuscript come from `R/method2_uncertainty.R`, which simulates from the fitted model's posterior and draws composition from its Dirichlet posterior.

### Ratio estimator

The ratio estimator found a donor within `r SEARCH_WINDOW` days for `r n_re_matched` of the `r nrow(recip)` unsampled strata; the remaining `r n_re_unmatched` strata (`r nfmt(catch_re_unmatched)` fish) had no sampled stratum in the same fishery and area within the search window. Across matched strata, the ratio estimator estimated `r nfmt(method1_all)` CWT recoveries, of which `r nfmt(method1_pst)` (`r round(100*method1_pst/method1_all)`%) were PST indicator stocks (@fig-res). The tag density model point estimate for the same strata is `r nfmt(td_on_matched)`. Of `r n_winter_recip` winter recipient strata, `r n_winter_summer_donor` borrowed from a summer donor. In the supplementary year-based search, `r t2_n` of the unmatched strata found a donor; `r t2_zero` of those donors recovered no CWTs.

## Appendix: ratio estimator pseudocode

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
For each unsampled stratum $u$:

1.  Identify all sampled strata $S$ in the same fishery and catch area.
2.  Compute the distance $|t_u - t_s|$ between month midpoints for each $s \in S$.
3.  Select the nearest $s$ with $|t_u - t_s| \leq 90$ days as the donor $d$; ties go to the earlier stratum.
4.  If no stratum qualifies, leave $u$ unestimated.
5.  Compute $\theta_d = N^{CWT}_d / N^{Sampled}_d$, using all tags physically present.
6.  For each stock-age category $k$, $\widehat{CWT}_{u,k} = N^{Caught}_u \cdot \theta_d \cdot p_{d,k}$, where $p_{d,k}$ is the donor's decoded-tag composition. A donor with zero recoveries contributes zero.
:::
